players.product: AI data center power: sidecar (out-of-rack) power, in-rack power supplies for centralized and distributed architectures, energy-storage compensation; SST in development

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue RMB 9,402,840,214.90, up 15.05% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 145,752,331.81, down 66.58%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 25,784,457.37, down 92.96%. Q4 2025 revenue RMB 2,611,593,533.21 with a net loss attributable of RMB -66,868,171.98. The company says intensifying competition and rising cost pressure hurt gross margin and profit; only the inverter home-appliance business missed expectations, and revenue of all other businesses combined grew 28.28%.

Power products segment (network power for telecom and data centers, medical, industrial, PV / storage / charging, display and OA power) revenue RMB 2,680,004,855.61 in 2025, up 13.88% YoY and 28.50% of company revenue; gross margin 22.33%, down 3.07 points. The company says its network power business keeps winning project demand and orders from international customers Ericsson, Cisco, Juniper, Arista and Accton, and that its server custom power projects have moved from development into delivery since the second half of 2025, with customer orders growing quickly.
quarterly_data.figure: Power products revenue RMB 2,680,004,855.61 (+13.88%), 28.50% of revenue; gross margin 22.33%

quarterly_data.signal: The company says it has become one of NVIDIA's designated recommended data-center power providers and is taking part in the design and ecosystem of power systems and high-voltage DC power solutions for NVIDIA Blackwell and Vera Rubin architecture data centers. Products it lists: for GB200/300 a 33kW Power Shelf, 15kW Super Capacitor Shelf and 16.5kW BBU Shelf; for Vera Rubin a 110kW Power Shelf, Liquid Cooling Power Shelf and 33kW Super Capacitor Shelf; for the next HVDC / SST platform an 800V/570kW Side Rack, 800V DC-DC Power Shelf and 800V-50V/12V PDB. Its SST takes grid high-voltage input and outputs 800VDC at over 98.5% conversion efficiency; its sidecar HVDC cabinet converts 480V/380VAC to 800VDC, fits NVIDIA Kyber and other high-density racks and supports 1MW+ per rack.
quarterly_data.figure: 110kW Power Shelf (Vera Rubin); 33kW Power Shelf (GB200/300); 800V/570kW Side Rack; SST efficiency over 98.5%

quarterly_data.signal: AI data center power status: in 2025 most AI data center power customer demand and projects were still in pre-mass-production development and debugging; the company received several small-batch sample and trial-production orders, and projects began moving into batch delivery from the end of 2025, so the business made no material financial contribution to 2025 results. As of the report date it had delivered batch volumes on project demand for some large North American customers and was in custom development and sample testing of next-generation products with several other leading North American cloud vendors. In China it has broken through with some leading domestic cloud vendors and passed qualification with most server makers, and expects to complete batch delivery of its first domestic project in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: First domestic AI data center power project batch delivery expected in 2026

quarterly_data.signal: R&D expense RMB 1,122,337,491.07 in 2025, up 14.05% YoY and 11.94% of revenue; 3,090 R&D staff. Key AI data center R&D projects: a 3RU 110kW centralized power system for Vera Rubin series GPU servers (validation stage; the company expects the single product to bring over RMB 10 hundred million of sales); a 1U 33kW centralized power system for GB300 series GPU servers (released; expected over RMB 2 hundred million of sales); a 1RU 90kW 800Vdc-to-50Vdc centralized power system for next-generation 800Vdc GPU servers (validation); a MW-level sidecar HVDC system converting 480VAC/380VAC to 800V (validation); a CBS 30kW supercapacitor system (released); and a power system for liquid-cooled supernode server clusters compatible with multiple domestic GPU cards (validation).
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 1,122,337,491.07 (+14.05%), 11.94% of revenue; 110kW Vera Rubin system expected over RMB 10 hundred million of sales

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers were 17.49% of 2025 sales (RMB 1,645,168,624.22); the largest 5.04% (RMB 474,305,350.34), then 4.15%, 2.85%, 2.75% and 2.70%; names not disclosed; related-party sales among them 0.00%.

Top five suppliers were 12.84% of 2025 purchases (RMB 824,301,322.49); the largest 4.03% (RMB 258,595,116.40), then 2.66%, 2.59%, 1.90% and 1.66%; names not disclosed; related-party purchases among them 0.00%.

Direct overseas revenue RMB 27.93 hundred million in 2025, up 4.39% YoY and 29.70% of total revenue; indirect overseas revenue was about 9% of total, so revenue from overseas demand (direct plus indirect) was close to 40%.
quarterly_data.figure: Direct overseas revenue RMB 27.93 hundred million (+4.39%), 29.70% of revenue; about 9% indirect

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: the company has full local delivery in India and is adding capacity in Thailand, where phase one of its own plant is built and in use (the Thailand plant construction project was at 100.00% progress at end-2025); it says using Thailand capacity largely avoids US tariffs. Construction in progress was RMB 398,084,224.86 at end-2025 (start of year RMB 599,147,137.45), lower mainly because buildings were transferred to fixed assets.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand plant project 100.00% progress; construction in progress RMB 398,084,224.86

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (company outlook): the company is optimistic that its business will keep growing steadily in 2026; it will keep high-intensity R&D, expand sales of growth products and core-customer coverage and push overseas. Its power business has moved from the R&D investment stage into delivery, and it expects network power (telecom and data center power) and PV / storage / charging to have the larger growth room, with the chance of large order conversion and sales growth in some key projects. It plans to gradually increase its fixed-asset investment plan and build global capacity and supply capability in China and abroad.
